reason: If I saw it in a café I'd grab one just to see what yerba mate tastes like, but at 55 a can I'm not swapping out my Big Shock or Monster that I get for half that on offer.
objection: 55 CZK for one can when I can get a 4-pack of energy drinks on sale for not much more. And 80 mg is less kick than a big Monster before the gym.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal that gets it down to around 35 CZK a can, ideally in a normal supermarket so I don't have to order online.
